sourceTitle: Financial support, fees and allowances (Foster with Northumberland, Northumberland County Council)

fees.label: Short break carer
fees.note: For carers available at least one weekend a month and two weeks of the school holidays

feesNote: Carers move up the fee bands as they build skills, experience and training, and an extra fee is paid for each additional child; the page dates the allowance table April 2026 to March 2027 but gives no separate date for the fee table.
extras: Holiday, birthday and festival allowances (amounts not published on the page)
Up to 14 days' paid leave a year covering the fee, plus up to 14 more days for holidays with the children
Fee kept for up to three months off sick
Mileage at 45p a mile for travel beyond everyday care
summary: Northumberland pays a weekly allowance for each child in five age bands for April 2026 to March 2027, plus a weekly fee for the carer that rises through three bands, with a higher fee for Mockingbird hub carers. Full-time carers get a guaranteed fee, and payments are made every two weeks.
